name: RARARA!: Series of Dreams
source:
Rudy finds himself trapped in an old farmhouse, hunted by a predatory creature that roams freely. The game revolves around stealth, simple resource gathering and crafting, and small decisions that affect Rudy’s chances of escaping safely.

[From [url=https://blockisaac.itch.io/rarara-series-of-dreams]Itch.io[/url]]
